title: Write the solution
text: With $$r=0.2$$, $$K=1000000$$, and $$P_0=1$$, the logistic solution can be written as $$P=\frac{K}{1+\left(K-1\right) e^{-0.2 t}}$$.

title: Solve for $$t$$
text: $$500000$$ is $$\frac{K}{2}$$, so we need $$\left(K-1\right) e^{-0.2 t}=1$$. That gives $$t=\frac{\ln\left(999999\right)}{0.2}$$, which is about $$69.08$$ hours.
